decisions.title: An operator waiver does not skip dispatch of a fresh review
decisions.rationale: The review that ran is still recorded next to the waiver, so the audit trail shows what the operator overrode.

decisions.title: A current stored verdict with blocking findings is re-reviewed, not reused
decisions.rationale: Reuse is reserved for verdicts the predicate would pass; re-dispatch on the same head matches the behaviour before this change.
